name: SecCraft
description: A hands-on cybersecurity learning platform where learners don't just consume security content — they investigate systems, perform security testing, collect evidence, understand impact, remediate vulnerabilities, retest fixes, and complete realistic assessments. Learn, practice, investigate, improve — in a safe, legal, zero-hardware environment.
philosophy: Learn → Practice → Investigate → Evidence → Impact → Improve → Report

logo.concept: SecCraft — Shield with checkmark + magnifying glass — shield in cyan #33CFFF represents protection and hardening, checkmark represents validation and proof, magnifying glass in orange #FF9F1C represents investigation. Learn. Practice. Investigate. Improve. Dark navy #0a0f3d background. Technical professional, serious, premium, hands-on craft.
logo.platformIcon: shield with checkmark + magnifying glass — cyan shield + orange magnifier
logo.wirelessPathIcon: shield with checkmark + magnifying glass + subtle Wi-Fi arcs for Wireless path

principles.domainAgnosticCore: Platform engine should not assume Wi-Fi
principles.domainSpecificContent: Wireless terminology and tooling belong inside Wireless path
principles.reusableLabEngine: Same lab framework should support PCAP, Web, API, Android, network, containers
principles.reusableAssessmentEngine: Assessment workflows should support different security domains
principles.reusableEvidenceModel: Evidence should work for PCAP, screenshots, HTTP, terminal, logs, configs, Android artifacts
principles.craftsmanship: Security is a craft — learn, practice, investigate, improve, with evidence
